headline: Recommended final passage of stop signs at French Street and Abbott Street, and recommended granting the Juliana Avenue street acceptance petition.
summary: The committee heard an update on the Mohawk Tannery Project remediation. It recommended final passage of O-26-024, which authorizes additional stop signs to make an all way stop at French Street and Abbott Street. It also recommended granting the petition to accept Juliana Avenue as a street, after a public hearing where no testimony was given.
decisions: Recommended final passage of O-26-024, authorizing additional stop signs to make an all way stop at the intersection of French Street and Abbott Street, 4-0.
Recommended granting the Petition for Street Acceptance – Juliana Avenue, 4-0.
